description: DaisyRose 27B is RadixArk’s multimodal reasoning model for coding, tool use and long-horizon agent tasks. Built from Qwen3.8-27B using reinforcement learning without supervised fine-tuning or distillation, it accepts text and images and returns text. It supports function calling, JSON-schema output and a 262,144-token context window, with up to 65,536 output tokens. Thinking is on by default; choose low, medium or high effort, or turn it off. The weights are released under Apache 2.0.
name: DaisyRose 27B
